description: A lightweight, data-driven quest framework for Unity 2022.3 LTS: QuestDefinition ScriptableObjects, Kill / Collect / Talk / ReachLocation objectives, QuestManager with Accept / Track / Complete / Abandon, chain quests, prerequisites, rewards, events for UI, and serializable save data. No paid dependencies. v0.1.0 is UNTESTED IN UNITY.
